provenance.method: lesson notes written from the NERDC 2025 scheme of work outline; every week keeps its scheme topic and bullets as the teaching spine

topics.title: Allah created all things
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to state that Allah created all things
The pupils should be able to say Alhamdulillah

Introduction:
We learn about Allah today
Allah is our creator

Content:
Allah made the world
Allah made the sky
Allah made the ground
Allah made the trees
Allah made the animals
Allah made you
Allah made me
We say Alhamdulillah
Alhamdulillah means praise be to Allah

Class activity:
Point to things in class
Say Allah made this

Evaluation questions:
Who made the world?
What do we say when we see good things?
Can you name something Allah created?

Summary:
Allah created all things
We say Alhamdulillah for Allah's creation

topics.title: Allah created me
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to explain that Allah created them
The pupils should be able to thank Allah for their creation

Introduction:
We learned Allah created all things
Today we learn Allah created me

Content:
Allah made me special
Allah gave me eyes to see
Allah gave me ears to hear
Allah gave me hands to hold
Allah gave me legs to walk
Allah made me to worship Him
We thank Allah for making us

Class activity:
Touch your body parts
Say Allah gave me this

Evaluation questions:
Who made you?
What can Allah given you help you do?
How do we thank Allah?

Summary:
Allah created me special
I thank Allah for making me

topics.title: The Prophet Muhammad (SAW)
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to identify the Prophet Muhammad
The pupils should be able to state that we love the Prophet

Introduction:
We learn about Allah's messenger today
His name is Prophet Muhammad

Content:
The Prophet Muhammad is Allah's messenger
He lived a simple life
He was kind to everyone
He loved children
He taught us about Allah
We love the Prophet Muhammad
We say peace be upon him

Class activity:
Practice saying Muhammad peace be upon him
Draw a simple picture of the Prophet

Evaluation questions:
Who is Allah's messenger?
How did the Prophet live?
What do we say about the Prophet?

Summary:
The Prophet Muhammad is Allah's messenger
We love and follow him

topics.title: The Mosque
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to identify the mosque
The pupils should be able to state that we respect the mosque

Introduction:
The Prophet taught us to pray
We pray in a special place

Content:
The mosque is the house of Allah
We go to mosque to pray
The mosque is clean and quiet
We take off shoes in mosque
We sit nicely in mosque
We do not make noise in mosque
We respect the mosque

Class activity:
Draw a simple mosque
Show how to behave in mosque

Evaluation questions:
What is the mosque?
How do we behave in mosque?
Why do we respect the mosque?

Summary:
The mosque is Allah's house
We must respect the mosque

topics.title: Simple Du'a: before eating
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to recite Bismillah before eating
The pupils should be able to recite Alhamdulillah after eating

Introduction:\ Allah gives us food to eat
We must thank Allah before and after eating

Content:
We say Bismillah before eating
Bismillah means in the name of Allah
We say Alhamdulillah after eating
Alhamdulillah means praise be to Allah
These are simple du'a
Du'a is talking to Allah

Class activity:
Practice saying Bismillah and Alhamdulillah
Make a pretend meal and practice

Evaluation questions:
What do we say before eating?
What do we say after eating?
What does Bismillah mean?

Summary:
We say Bismillah before food
We say Alhamdulillah after food

topics.title: The Qur'an is Allah's book
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to identify the Qur'an
The pupils should be able to state that we love the Qur'an

Introduction:
Allah sent messages to us
His message is in the Qur'an

Content:
The Qur'an is Allah's book
Allah sent the Qur'an to Prophet Muhammad
The Qur'an has Allah's words
We must respect the Qur'an
We hold the Qur'an carefully
We listen when Qur'an is recited
We love the Qur'an

Class activity:
Show a Qur'an
Practice holding it nicely

Evaluation questions:
What is the Qur'an?
Who sent the Qur'an?
How do we treat the Qur'an?

Summary:
The Qur'an is Allah's book
We love and respect the Qur'an

topics.title: Saying Salam
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to say Assalamu Alaikum
The pupils should be able to reply to Salam

Introduction:
We must greet people nicely
Islam teaches us how to greet

Content:
We say Assalamu Alaikum
Assalamu Alaikum means peace be upon you
When someone greets us we reply
We say Wa Alaikumus Salam
Wa Alaikumus Salam means and upon you peace
Greeting is good manners

Class activity:
Practice greeting each other
Say Assalamu Alaikum and reply

Evaluation questions:
What do we say when greeting?
How do we reply to Salam?
What does Assalamu Alaikum mean?

Summary:
We say Assalamu Alaikum
We reply Wa Alaikumus Salam

topics.title: Allah gives us food
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to state that Allah provides food
The pupils should be able to thank Allah for food

Introduction:
We eat food every day
Who gives us our food?

Content:
Allah gives us food
Allah makes the food grow
Allah sends the rain
Allah makes the sun shine
Allah gives us food to eat
We must thank Allah for food
We say Alhamdulillah for food

Class activity:
Name different foods
Say Allah gave us this food

Evaluation questions:
Who gives us food?
What does Allah do for our food?
How do we thank Allah for food?

Summary:
Allah provides all our food
We say thank you to Allah

topics.title: Love one another
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to explain that we should be kind
The pupils should be able to name kind actions

Introduction:
The Prophet taught us to love each other
We must be kind to everyone

Content:
We must love one another
We must be kind to friends
We share with friends
We help friends when they need help
We do not fight with friends
We speak nicely to each other
Kindness makes Allah happy

Class activity:
Act out kind actions
Share a small treat with a friend

Evaluation questions:
What does Allah want us to do?
How can we show kindness?
Why is kindness important?

Summary:
We must love and be kind to each other
Kindness makes Allah happy

topics.title: Revision and assessment
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to recall what they learned
The pupils should be able to recite simple du'a

Introduction:
Today we review all we learned this term
We will practice our lessons

Content:
We learned Allah created all things
We learned Allah created us
We learned about Prophet Muhammad
We learned about the mosque
We learned to say Bismillah and Alhamdulillah
We learned about the Qur'an
We learned to say Salam
We learned Allah gives us food
We learned to love one another

Class activity:
Recite all the du'a we learned
Answer questions about what we learned

Evaluation questions:
What did you learn about Allah?
What did you learn about the Prophet?
What du'a do we say before eating?

Summary:
We reviewed all our lessons
We must remember what we learned
